name: Lateral Ankle Instability - Chronic
definition: Recurrent giving-way and/or mechanical instability after lateral ankle sprain, involving functional sensorimotor deficits and sometimes persistent ligament laxity.

investigations.principle: Diagnosis is mainly clinical; radiographs/MRI are used for persistent symptoms or associated structural lesions.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, labral, tendon, ligament, infection, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Persistent mechanical instability despite rehabilitation may require ligament reconstruction.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Gulpha-Snayu asthirata phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Recurrent giving-way and/or mechanical instability after lateral ankle sprain, involving functional sensorimotor deficits and sometimes persistent ligament laxity.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, rapidly progressive weakness, suspected serious infection, airway/vascular symptoms, unreduced dislocation or other listed red flags.

sources.title: Lateral Ankle Sprain Clinical Practice Guideline
